SELECT student_course_id, cnt
FROM (
    SELECT student_course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT transcript_id) AS cnt
    FROM Transcript_Contents
    GROUP BY student_course_id
) t
WHERE cnt = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT student_course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT transcript_id) AS cnt
        FROM Transcript_Contents
        GROUP BY student_course_id
    )
);

SELECT student_course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT transcript_id) AS max_count
FROM Transcript_Contents
GROUP BY student_course_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT transcript_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT student_course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT transcript_id) AS cnt
        FROM Transcript_Contents
        GROUP BY student_course_id
    )
);
SELECT student_course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT transcript_id) AS cnt FROM Transcript_Contents GROUP BY student_course_id ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10;
